facts.fact: 暴雨毫无预兆地砸向宅子与花园，Tigglestide Eve 夜里全屋被雨围住
facts.anchor: The storm came without warning, and great bucketloads of rain pelted the house and drenched the gardens.

facts.fact: Sandy 独自坐在只剩手机屏光照亮的黑房间里
facts.anchor: Inside Hollyoak House, Sandy was all alone, sitting in a dark room illuminated only by the glow from the screen of their phone.

facts.fact: Sandy 反复念着爸爸一定会回家，靠这个念头撑着
facts.anchor: Dad’s coming home,” Sandy told themself. “Dad’s got to come home.

facts.fact: 手机反复刷新，等来的始终是没有信号
facts.anchor: They hit REFRESH again and waited for the signal to time out again.

facts.fact: George 冒雨到窗下扔石子求 Sandy 放自己进屋
facts.anchor: When Sandy went to investigate, they saw that George was below, throwing pebbles.

facts.fact: Sandy 怒斥 George 曾给自己下药，质问对方懂不懂同意
facts.anchor: You dosed me! Don’t you know anything about consent?

facts.fact: George 自白从来没真信过 Round Robin，昨天亲眼所见后不知道该信什么
facts.anchor: I never believed in Round Robin, not for real.

facts.fact: 两人摊牌补读第三张，翻出的是 Devil
facts.anchor: They pulled the third and final card. It was the Devil.
